Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread/transcribed Edward Dearle’s death year as 1861 instead of 1891, despite the WebSurfer’s sources (e.g., Wikipedia, Blue Letter Bible, Born Glorious) clearly showing 20 March 1891. This led to an incorrect lifespan (55 years) for Dearle and the wrong final conclusion that Michael Doeberl lived longer.
